pages.title: What Sets AeroIE Apart
pages.text: 1. By combining code from the RPLlib dependency with Giant Salted Fish's knowledge of discrete control systems, AeroIE improves entity motion and ray tracing. Its projectiles can travel at high speed through unloaded chunks with low performance cost, remain visible, and hit accurately, although they cannot collide with terrain there. AeroIE also provides more efficient long-range ray tracing with the same unloaded-terrain limitation.$(br2)2. Because multiblock structures often have compatibility problems during physical assembly and dimension changes, AeroIE uses enlarged single-block models instead. This makes large peripherals far more reliable.$(br2)3. AeroIE simplifies piloting and vehicle construction. Thrusters, for example, need no precise position or orientation calibration, and builders do not need to account for center-of-mass offsets or air pressure.

pages.title: Fun Fact
pages.text: Unfortunately, KODU16 does not know how to implement a true chunk cache. If you do, pull requests that solve terrain collision in unloaded chunks are welcome.
